subject: Offer call + DocuSign routing — Senior ML Engineer (Samira Khan)
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@example.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Offer call — Senior ML Engineer (proposed times + draft)

Hi Samira —

Great speaking with you yesterday. We're excited to extend a formal offer for the Senior ML Engineer role. I’d like to set aside 20 minutes for an offer walkthrough so we can go through comp, equity, benefits, and the DocuSign package, and answer any questions you have. Proposed times (PT):

- Tue, Nov 9 — 10:00–10:20am
- Tue, Nov 9 — 3:00–3:20pm
- Wed, Nov 10 — 9:30–9:50am

If none of those work, tell me a couple windows that do and I’ll adjust. I’ve attached the draft offer (PDF) and a short comp summary.

Notes up front: the draft uses our standard indemnity and IP language; if you have edits, flag them during the call and we’ll route to legal. For timing, we typically aim for a start date 4–6 weeks after signed offer; happy to discuss earlier or later.

Attachments: Redwood_Offer_Draft_Samira_20261105.pdf; Comp_Summary_20261105.xlsx

Best,
Mina

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@example.com>

Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Offer call — Senior ML Engineer (proposed times + draft)

Hi Mina —

Thanks — I can do Tue, Nov 9 at 3:00pm PT. Please lock that in.

Couple quick questions before the call:
1) I’d like to propose a start date of Jan 10, 2027 instead of the 4–6 weeks default — I have a contractor transition to finish. Would that be acceptable?
2) I skimmed the draft and noticed the indemnity paragraph (section 7) is a bit broader than I expected. My attorney will likely request a small carve-out for open-source contributions. I don’t expect a major redline but want to flag it so we can discuss.

Happy to talk through on Tuesday.

Thanks,
Samira

Markus/Laura — forwarding Samira's reply: she confirmed Tue 11/9 at 3pm PT and asked to shift start to Jan 10, 2027. Also called out a potential indemnity carve-out (open-source).

Two asks before the call:
- Can we confirm a Jan 10 start is ok from the hiring team perspective? (Markus)
- If the legal carve-out is reasonable, can we pre-authorize small language tweaks so we can move quickly after the call? (Laura/legal)

I’ll leave Samira on copy so she sees the internal tempo. We’re planning to present the offer on the call and then send a DocuSign envelope.

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Offer call — Senior ML Engineer (proposed times + draft)

Thanks for the heads up. Jan 10, 2027 is acceptable from our side; it gives a clean transition window and aligns with the team ramp plan. Compensation as in the draft is approved (base + 20% target bonus + equity grant noted in the comp summary).

About the indemnity: our standard position is to allow a limited carve-out for prior open-source contributions that do not use Redwood proprietary code or data. Laura/Monica — can legal review and prepare a single-sentence modification that we can pre-authorize for low-friction execution? If it looks like a larger redline, please flag and we’ll escalate.

Monica — looping you to confirm you can send the DocuSign envelope after the call and apply the approved tweak. If you need any additional approvals, tell us the timeline.

Markus

Hi Samira —

Confirmed for Tue, Nov 9 at 3:00pm PT. Calendar invite sent. Looking forward to walking through the offer.

Quick updates based on internal alignment:
- Start date: Jan 10, 2027 is fine. We’ll include that in the final offer.
- Indemnity clause: legal has agreed to prepare a concise carve-out for prior open-source contributions that don’t rely on Redwood code/data. I’ve attached an updated offer (Redwood_Offer_Samira_v2_20261106.pdf) that includes that clause.
- DocuSign: Monica will send the envelope after the call. We’ll prepare two signature options in the envelope (Samira + manager). You should receive an automated DocuSign email from docusign@notifications.docusign.com later Tue evening if the call goes as planned.

Attachments: Redwood_Offer_Samira_v2_20261106.pdf

If anything changes before the call, reply to this thread. Otherwise, see you Tuesday.
